_comment: Option C curation (ruling 2026-19: template NAME = what the workflow does, no chain separator / no arrow of any kind; the mechanism stays in the description). Of the 64 linear (node-sequence) patterns, 32 are node+edge sub-paths of already-shipped DAG patterns (which carry the good outcome names) and 8 contain plumbing nodes (jipipe:comment / node-group) - both excluded. The 24 survivors below are the genuinely linear-only workflows, each given an outcome name in the DAG naming style. The linear generator (generate-system-template-metadata.py) reads this file: the keep-set is enforced and the name is OVERRIDDEN with the outcome name (the mined chain name is no longer shipped). Keys are the shipped graph-file stems (== sidecar keys).
